own_solution.law: Rutherford (Coulomb) hyperbolic orbit with fixed centre: r_min = (d/2)(1 + 1/sin(theta/2)), d = (2)(79) e^2 / (4 pi eps0 K); energy and angular momentum conservation.

TA405.regime: Nuclear size matters only if the closest approach (54.9 fm) reaches the nuclear surface; 7.3 fm << 54.9 fm, so the point-Coulomb result holds.

T69BD.regime: Charge radius matters only if the alpha penetrates the nuclear charge distribution; 7.3 fm << 54.9 fm.

notes: Working: e/(4 pi eps0) = 1.602e-19 * 8.98774e9 = 1.43984e-9 V m; d = 158 * 1.43984e-9 / 5e6 V = 4.5499e-14 m (45.50 fm); r_min = 22.749 fm * (1 + sqrt2) = 54.92 fm. With 8.6 MeV: 54.92 * 5/8.6 = 31.93 fm. T381B and T5616 state no number ('a little'); they are qualitative variants of TE67A and TABD0 and do not affect the answer either way. With 8.6 MeV the closest approach (31.9 fm) still exceeds 7.3 fm, so the K regime is also respected under the R sentences.
